screen.intro: While it's on, only company-wide admins can work. Everyone else sees a notice.
screen.until_help: Shown to staff only. Maintenance stays on until you turn it off.
screen.message_help: Optional, up to 200 characters each. If one is empty, the other is shown.
screen.saved_on: Maintenance mode is ON. Staff now see the notice.
screen.saved_off: Maintenance mode is OFF. Staff can work again.

notice.title: Under maintenance
notice.body: The app is closed for a short time. Anything you were saving was not saved — do it again when it's back.
